_about: Exact find/replace fixes for bugs in original demo projects, applied to a copy of the source before building (never to the zips). Paths are relative to the project root. Each applied patch is listed in the demo report.

scroll-21.why: the script animates #gallery-9 but the page only has 8 galleries

svg-8.why: the page has no .content--related footer, which crashed the loop before any scroll watcher was created

scroll-42.why: the cube has 36 faces but the zip ships 33 images; faces 34-36 reuse images 1-3

sliders-10.replace: <script type="module">import * as Tweakpane from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tweakpane@4.0.4/dist/tweakpane.min.js"; window.Tweakpane = Tweakpane;</script>
sliders-10.why: Tweakpane 4 is ES-module only, so the plain <script> tag never defined window.Tweakpane
the demo script now runs after the Tweakpane module, in document order

scroll-65.why: window wheel listeners are passive by default, so preventDefault() was ignored and the page scrolled under the slide transition
